en: The image is a black-and-white postcard showing a quaint, wooden railway station building with a traditional pitched tile roof, several windows, and benches outside. There is a sign above the entrance that says 'MÄRSTA'. A clock is visible on the building, and there are flower pots and trees around the station. The style is typical of early to mid-20th century Northern European railway stations.
